entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.4023 Of 2023
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioner to quash the proceedings against him in FIR No.27 of 2023 on the file of Station House Officer, Chigurumamidi Police Station, Karimnagar District.

The offence alleged against the petitioner is under Sections 420, 403, 468, 471 and 409 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC').
2.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent - State.
3. The 2nd respondent lodged the complaint stating that the petitioner had indulged in misappropriating the money, which was lying in the account of the customers.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that none of the account holders have given complaint and the question of misappropriation does not arise and false complaint is made for various other reasons.

5. Since the misappropriation is part of the record as alleged by the 2nd respondent, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the Investigating Officer in FIR No.27 of 2023 on the file of Station House Officer, Chigurumamidi Police Station, Karimnagar District, to conclude the investigation without taking any coercive steps against the petitioner - Accused for a period of three weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
Further, the petitioner - Accused shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required for the purpose of investigation.
6. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.

K.SURENDER, J Date: 21.04.2023 Kgk THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE K.SURENDER CRIMINAL PETITION NO.4023 OF 2023 Date: 21.04.2023 Kgk Sri Merugu Manohar vs The State Of Telangana on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34335880/
